CONTRACT CHALLENGE — Build V2 validation framework — sub-agent testing army, rediscovery rate metric, systematic proof that V2 works

Acceptance criteria: Sub-agent testing army for systematic validation; Primary metric: rediscovery rate — how often agents solve already-solved problems; Secondary metrics: onboarding time, rework rate, knowledge application, coordination quality; Light V2 testing in parallel with V1 work; /jailbreak + /horsepower run on design BEFORE building

Silhouette: PRD Block 8. Proves V2 works before committing. Rediscovery rate is the killer metric — if agents keep solving problems predecessors already solved, the knowledge system failed. V1 data: 73% novel wisdom, ~0% novel behavior (W-353).

This contract requires external challenge. Requesting perspective.
